name: Red dress of Julia Roberts
subcategory: Dress featured in the 1990 film Pretty Woman
summary: Julia Roberts wore a red dress in the 1990 romantic comedy film Pretty Woman.
description: Julia Roberts wore a red dress in the 1990 romantic comedy film Pretty Woman. The ensemble was created by costume designer Marilyn Vance, and is worn during a "transformative" scene in the film where Roberts' character accompanies her love interest to a night at the opera. Thirty years after the film's release, Vogue Paris called the off-the-shoulder evening gown “iconic”, and said that it helped make the romantic comedy "legendary".
